scenes.title: Your appointment
scenes.caption: What the letter says, and what to do.
scenes.say: You have a hospital letter. Here's what it says, and what you need to do about it.

scenes.title: What it is
scenes.caption: An ear, nose and throat clinic appointment.
scenes.say: The hospital has booked you into the ear, nose and throat clinic, because your GP referred you about hearing loss in your left ear.

scenes.title: When and where
scenes.caption: Tuesday 8 December, arrive by 10.25am.
scenes.say: It's Tuesday the eighth of December. The appointment is at twenty to eleven, but arrive by twenty-five past ten.

scenes.title: How long
scenes.caption: Allow up to two hours.
scenes.say: You'll have a hearing test before you see the doctor, so it may take up to two hours.

scenes.title: Before you come
scenes.caption: No ear drops for a week. Bring your medicines list.
scenes.say: Don't use ear drops for a week before. Bring a list of your medicines, and your reading glasses. One adult may come too.

scenes.title: Getting here
scenes.caption: Parking is limited. The number 12 bus stops outside.
scenes.say: Parking is limited, but the number twelve bus stops outside the main entrance. Need hospital transport? Ring at least three working days before.

scenes.title: Can't come?
scenes.caption: Ring as soon as you can.
scenes.say: If you can't come, ring the number on your letter soon as you can. Miss it without telling them, and you may be sent back to your GP.

faults: scene 2: the letter from the hospital to you is cued on words Peter never says, so it arrives on a guess; the GP's letter also seems to fly out of nowhere
scene 4: the clock stands on a red cross on the wall, so it looks muddled, and the meter sits over 'You' as if it were a health bar; the walk does nothing because 'You' is already in place
scene 5: the picture shows only two of the four things Peter says (drops, list). Glasses and the adult are missing. A cross on ear drops is fine, but the medicine list is the only tick
scene 6: nothing shows Parking is limited or the bus arriving. The phone floats in the air with no one ringing it
scene 7: a tick on the hospital shows 'fine' while Peter talks about missing the appointment. The home place with a hospital inside it is odd, and Reelie's bubble comes late, after the point
scene 7: the person is not shown ringing, and the GP return is not shown
